_approach: Two-bar kick-roll build: bar 1 adds 8th kicks on beats 3-4, bar 2 doubles to 8ths then 16ths with velocity climbing to 127 on the last step while the hats go from offbeat 8ths to a rising 16th wall. EDMProd warns to high-pass the kick as the roll accelerates; the last kick+crash is the loudest hit. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
